name: pixel-pet
description: Bit the pixel puppy, in two layouts. Side pane: the session's status and ticket beside the chat (TL;DR, PRs, experiments, config drafts, links, people) over Slack, its Code Review, its Related Sessions and running agents, and a sticky context footer with model and cache, every section foldable. Band: sessions board (waiting, running, merged, idle), merge-ready lane, push guard and failure classifier, CI why, preview chip, Slack inbox with per-message dismiss, needs-you inbox, usage projection, hygiene guards, actions pane with a favorite, /bit rituals, worktree janitor, merge impact watch; plus plan progress, cache line with Summarize, start fresh, critique, ELI5

extraBots.title: Extra bots
extraBots.description: GitHub logins to leave out of review counts, beside the common review and CI bots

previewMarker.title: Preview comment
previewMarker.description: Text in the PR comment that carries the preview link; empty hides the preview link

previewLinkMatch.title: Preview link match
previewLinkMatch.description: Text the preview link contains; empty takes the first https link in that comment

globalsFiles.title: Globals files
globalsFiles.description: Repo files with a GLOBALS=(...) list of paths whose change rebuilds every app

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: band: Bit above the prompt. side-pane: Bit in a pane beside the chat, with the session's ticket, Slack, code review, related sessions and context

codeRepo.title: Code repo
codeRepo.description: side-pane: owner/name of the repo whose PRs make the Code lane; its owner is the org PR search covers

configRepo.title: Config repo
configRepo.description: side-pane: owner/name of the repo whose PRs make the Config lane; empty leaves the lane out

linearServer.title: Linear server
linearServer.description: side-pane: the MCP server to read tickets from, as /mcp lists it; empty finds the one with get_issue

slackDomain.title: Slack domain
slackDomain.description: side-pane: your workspace domain (acme.slack.com), for DM links to the people on the ticket

designer.title: Designer
designer.description: side-pane: the designer's full Slack name, listed under People as design

experimentType.title: Experiment config type
experimentType.description: side-pane: the config type of experiments (EXPERIMENT_V3); empty hides experiments and drafts

configCli.title: Config CLI
configCli.description: side-pane: a CLI with `config search` and `curl` subcommands that lists configs and loads drafts

draftPath.title: Draft path
draftPath.description: side-pane: the API path that loads a config draft, with {code} for its code

variantQuery.title: Variant query
variantQuery.description: side-pane: the query that forces a variant, with {name}, {variant} and {zone} (exp={name}$${variant}&zone={zone})
